2609.21659.title: Outcome-Conditioned End-Effector Geometry Across Vision-Language-Action Policies
2609.21659.paper_summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies solve the same manipulation task through different action interfaces, but task success alone does not establish whether their physical executions agree. We study cross-policy end-effector geometry in 15,000 closed-loop LIBERO rollouts from four policies. The primary clean-condition analysis forms 3,600 configuration-matched, and therefore dependent, policy pairs. Both-success pairs have a median normalized dynamic time warping distance of 0.0120 m versus 0.0380 m when exactly one policy succeeds. This ordering holds in every task, every policy pair, and nine sampling and band-limited representations; however, the ratio varies severalfold across representations, so we report the direction rather than a fixed multiple. Both-failure pairs are more separated again but rest on thin, uneven support, so we report them as exploratory. Within successful executions, partner replacements separate more across tasks than across initial states. A matched baseline still reveals measurable, heterogeneous residual policy differences, so a low cross-policy distance does not imply interchangeability. Successful executions sit about as far from same-task demonstrations as those demonstrations sit from each other, compatible with task-associated geometry without separating training-data overlap from task constraints. A common 72-action window preserves the ordering but reduces its magnitude; endpoint and duration adjustment likewise leaves a positive mixed-outcome coefficient relative to both-success pairs, though its magnitude is specification-dependent. Under composite visual stress, policy rankings and pair composition change together.
2609.21659.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言-行動（VLA）政策透過不同的行動介面解決相同的操作任務，但僅僅依賴任務成功並不能確定它們的實際執行是否一致。我們研究了來自四個政策的 15,000 次閉環 LIBERO 執行中的跨政策末端效應器幾何。主要的清潔條件分析形成了 3,600 個配置匹配的、因此相互依賴的政策對。當恰好有一個政策成功時，兩個成功的政策對的中位數標準化動態時間扭曲距離為 0.0120 米，而當兩個政策都成功時則為 0.0380 米。這一排序在每個任務、每對政策以及九種取樣和帶限表示中都成立；然而，該比率在不同表示中變化多端，因此我們報告方向而不是固定的倍數。兩個失敗的政策對則再次分開，但依賴於薄且不均勻的支持，因此我們將其報告為探索性結果。在成功的執行中，夥伴替換在任務之間的分離程度超過了初始狀態之間的分離程度。一個匹配的基準仍然顯示可測量的異質性殘餘政策差異，因此低的跨政策距離並不意味著可互換性。成功的執行距離相同任務的示範大約與這些示範彼此之間的距離相當，這與任務相關的幾何相容，並未將訓練數據的重疊與任務約束分開。常見的 72 個行動窗口保持了排序，但減少了其幅度；端點和持續時間的調整同樣相對於兩個成功的政策對留下了正的混合結果係數，儘管其幅度依賴於具體規範。在複合視覺壓力下，政策排名和對組成一起發生變化。
